Package com.egradx.auth.security

Class EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.security.EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxAttemptLimiter
public class EgradxInMemoryAttemptLimiter extends Object implements EgradxAttemptLimiter
Counts failures in memory, over a sliding window: at most maxFailuresPerAccount for one key from one address, and maxFailuresPerAddress from one address across every key. Once a limit is reached, the wait is until the oldest failure it counted leaves the window.

Each instance counts on its own, so with several the effective limits multiply by their number. Memory is bounded by maxTracked entries per count; beyond it the least recently seen are forgotten, which an attacker flooding addresses could use to forget their own — acceptable for a default, and a reason to count somewhere shared in production.
